회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다. Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다.
우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다. Coupang Ads 구성원들은 Coupang Ads를 일하기 좋은 곳으로 만드는데 큰 역할을 하며, 우리는 빠르게 변화하는 역동적인 환경에서 일하고 싶어하는 다양한 배경을 가진 사람들을 고용하고 개발하며, 각 직원이 존중과 권한을 부여 받고 지원받는다고 느낄 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다. 이런 환경과 사람들은 광고주를 대신하여 혁신적인 관점을 제공할 수 있습니다. 우리는 고객중심의 생각, 끈기, 사려 깊음, 그리고 신속한 행동을 직접 보여줄 수 있는 자질을 중요하게 생각합니다.
우리의 목표는 세계 최고의 광고 팀에서 일하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 만드는 것입니다. 혁신적이고 역동적인 환경에서 업계를 선도하고, 팀과 함께 성장을 달성하고자 하는 열정적인 분이라면 Coupang Ads와 함께하세요.
Coupang Ads에서 여러분은 세계에서 가장 가치 있고 가장 빠르게 성장하는 광고 솔루션 중 하나를 제공하게 될 것입니다.
직무 소개
Ads Acquisition Support 팀은 쿠팡 광고를 이용 중이거나 광고 활용이 필요한 다양한 판매자의 성장을 지원하는 팀으로, 광고 컨설팅, 운영 가이드 및 문의 대응을 통해 광고 성과 향상을 돕고 있습니다.
여러 카테고리의 판매자와 소통하며 상황에 맞는 광고 솔루션을 제안하고, 이커머스 및 디지털 광고 비즈니스에 대한 이해를 넓혀 나갑니다. 또한 데이터 기반의 컨설팅과 커뮤니케이션 경험을 통해 광고 세일즈에 필요한 역량을 쌓고 판매자의 비즈니스 성장을 가까이에서 경험할 수 있습니다. 디지털 광고와 세일즈 분야에서 커리어를 시작하는 분들에게는 광고 세일즈의 기본기를 익히고 전문성을 키워갈 수 있는 좋은 출발점이 되며, 정규직 전환 기회가 열려 있어 업무 성과와 역량을 바탕으로 쿠팡 내에서 장기적인 커리어를 만들어 갈 수 있습니다.

당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (
recruitingops@coupang.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.description: What you will do Demonstrated ability to create realistic style character concept art for FPS games. Extreme proficiency in art fundamentals, research skill, and design principles. A sufficient understanding of the types and structures of firearms and have unique insights into the design of firearm skins. Demonstrated ability to work loosely with line drawings, and basic color render, to convey an idea rapidly and efficiently. Research and collect visual material to help define the visual style, and contents of the game. A strong communicator and able to convey abstract/sophisticated ideas in a concise way. Work closely with designer to consider the gameplay implications, and the overall player experience. Work closely to assist the 3D Lead, and Level Artists, to help define and visualize the details within a level. 10 years+ of working experience in character concept design. Shipped at least 1 - 2 games as a concept artist. Proficient in creating concept designs with rich detail and photorealistic aesthetics through techniques such as photobash. Good illustration and storytelling skills, with an eye for perspective, color, lighting, mood and composition. Good sense of form, shape, silhouette, scale and surface materials. Able to work in a fast-paced environment, working with individuals on the Design and Level-Art team, to help shape the levels Must have the initiative and agility, to adapt the work, to efficiently deliver to requirements. Ranging from line sketches, paint-over, basic color render, or full render, where appropriate. Strong use of research and reference material, in support of idea generation, and problem solving. Basic knowledge of 3D software packages, and experience employing 3D techniques into a concept workflow, is an advantage. Good awareness of 3D art pipelines, and technical constraints related to different game engines, is an advantage.

jobs.description: At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Engineering Manager to drive the strategic execution and delivery of Multifamily application platforms and full-stack digital capabilities built on modern Java-based microservices architecture, ensuring alignment with business objectives, seamless integration, compliance with regulations, and operational excellence. Our Impact: Freddie Mac's Multifamily division advances affordable rental housing by purchasing apartment loans from a national network of lenders and transforming those loans into securities that attract global investors. The Multifamily Technology Team plays a critical role in this mission by: Enabling Multifamily business teams to operate more efficiently through secure, scalable, and user-focused digital applications that support critical business processes across loan acquisition, asset management, securitization, risk, and portfolio operations. Modernizing application platforms and reducing manual dependencies to improve usability, operational efficiency, scalability, reliability, and confidence in the technology capabilities that support critical Multifamily business processes. Deliver secure, resilient, auditable, and well-architected platform capabilities that business teams can depend on to operate at scale, manage risk, meet regulatory expectations, and support long-term Multifamily growth. Your Impact: As a Software Engineering Manager, you will collaborate closely with Product Owners and business partners to deliver modern application platform capabilities that meet evolving end-user needs. You will lead multiple agile squads in designing and implementing resilient full-stack applications, APIs, and microservices-based solutions, while applying strong software engineering rigor through scalable design, automated testing, and operational excellence. In this leadership role, you will provide practical technical direction, drive continuous improvement, and identify opportunities to simplify delivery, improve efficiency, and strengthen the overall quality of Multifamily technology solutions. jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. Some of our most important work is making the agents and AI-powered experiences inside North genuinely useful in the workflows customers rely on every day. These systems become valuable when users can build with them, steer them, inspect their work, recover from errors, and trust them to complete messy tasks inside real enterprise environments. This role is about making those AI experiences reliable, useful, and production-ready. You’ll work with product engineering, modelling and design to turn model capability into reliable, user-facing systems: agent builders, eval frameworks, proactive intelligence, and new interfaces for collaborating with AI. Sometimes that means shipping a new product surface, sometimes a better eval or feedback loop, sometimes prompt and context experiments, and sometimes redesigning the workflow so the model is being asked to do the right thing. AS AN APPLIED AI ENGINEER, AGENTS & AUTOMATIONS, YOU WILL: - Build AI-powered product experiences that help users create, configure, evaluate, and improve workflows across North. - Design and ship new interfaces for interacting with models, including workflow builders, proactive assistants, review flows, and other human-AI collaboration patterns. - Build eval, observability, and feedback systems that measure whether AI experiences succeed in real enterprise workflows. - Improve AI reliability through product design, prompting, context construction, tool-use strategies, instrumentation, and feedback loops. - Turn production failures, user feedback, and real-task data into better product behavior, stronger eval suites, regression tests, and signals for modelling. - Work closely with modelling, product, design, customer teams, and domain experts to define what “good” means for specific workflows and ship measurable improvements. - Help decide when a workflow needs a more constrained product experience, a better model interface, a stronger eval, or a deeper modelling investment. Example problems you might work on include helping users build AI automations from natural language, creating evals for multi-step agent workflows, adding proactive intelligence inside the product, or creating interfaces that make agent behavior easier to inspect, steer, and trust. YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You have shipped LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-assisted product experiences into production, and improved them based on real-world feedback. - You are a strong software engineer who enjoys working across backend systems, user-facing product, data, evals, and model behavior. - You think in terms of user outcomes and system behavior, not just model metrics. - You have strong product taste and care about how the interface, workflow, and model work together to help users succeed. - You enjoy debugging messy real-world failures and turning what you learn from production, user testing, and evals into durable improvements. - You enjoy owning ambiguous problems end-to-end and working across system boundaries to ship something genuinely useful. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. Responsibilities Поддержка стандартов и процессов Идеальный Магазин Поддержка внедрения методологии сегментации Идеальный Магазин и принципов приоритизации торговых точек в канале традиционной торговли. Ведение баз данных сегментации, классификации торговых точек и инструментов приоритизации для обеспечения качественного планирования. Поддержка разработки и внедрения Retailer Value Offer (RVO) и Shopper Value Offer (SVO) по категориям и кластерам торговых точек. Адаптация RVO и SVO в стандарты Picture of Success (PoS) и руководства по исполнению для канала. Координация коммуникации и внедрения стандартов Идеального Магазина среди команд продаж и других заинтересованных сторон. Поддержка и совершенствование инструментов мониторинга, скоркарт и дашбордов. Контроль соблюдения стандартов Идеального Магазина, выявление пробелов в исполнении и возможностей для улучшения. Поддержка разработки и внедрения инструментов для торговых команд, мотивационных программ и решений по отчетности. Координация ежемесячного планирования задач SDO и отслеживания KPI для команд продаж канала TT. Сбор обратной связи от торговых команд и подготовка предложений по улучшению процессов и инструментов. Анализ тенденций эффективности Идеального Магазина, результатов соответствия стандартам и ключевых показателей исполнения. Мониторинг показателей категорий, дистрибуции, ассортимента, видимости продукции и качества исполнения в торговых точках. Подготовка аналитических обзоров, презентаций и рекомендаций на основе результатов работы канала. Участие в ежегодной оценке эффективности программы Идеальный Магазин и разработке планов улучшений. Поддержка создания аналитических инструментов и бизнес-решений для повышения эффективности канала. Обеспечение качества и достоверности данных в системах отчетности и базах данных. Поддержка адаптации и обучения торговых команд принципам и инструментам. Аналитика и контроль эффективности Поддержка оценки эффективности активаций и окупаемости инвестиций (ROI) через пост-анализ мероприятий и мониторинг результатов. Подготовка бизнес-кейсов и рекомендаций на основе коммерческой аналитики и полевых инсайтов. Поддержка процессов управления KPI, планов действий и контроля выполнения. Мониторинг бюджетов и затрат, связанных с активациями, для обеспечения эффективного использования ресурсов. Поддержка планирования и реализации активностей Поддержка разработки и реализации части Идеального Магазина в рамках Годового операционного плана (AOP) для канала традиционной торговли. Подготовка и поддержание расчетов Building Blocks, прогнозов и ежемесячных обновлений по ключевым KPI. Мониторинг достижения целей канала, включая: уровень покрытия оборудованием; представленность ассортимента MHL; соблюдение стандартов Идеального Магазина. Координация реализации календаря активаций и обеспечение своевременного выполнения запланированных мероприятий. Контроль сроков, бюджетов и ключевых этапов активаций. Поддержка кросс-функциональных команд при реализации категорийных и канальных активностей. Подготовка коммуникационных материалов, информационных пакетов и обновлений для команд продаж и руководства. Поддержка планирования и внедрения торгового оборудования, POS-материалов и инструментов исполнения. Координация ежегодных процессов, связанных с: установкой и мониторингом эффективности оборудования; подготовкой планограмм. Проведение пост-анализа активационных программ и инициатив Идеального Магазина. Выявление ключевых выводов и подготовка рекомендаций для дальнейшего совершенствования. Поддержка внедрения мероприятий по оптимизации на основе анализа результатов. Участие в коммерческих сессиях планирования и обзорах с дистрибьюторами для поддержки внедрения Идеального Магазина. Qualifications 2-4 года опыта в Sales, Trade Marketing, Category Management, Commercial Excellence, Demand Planning, Business Analytics или смежных коммерческих функциях. Опыт участия в программах повышения эффективности продаж, подготовке отчетности или трейд-маркетинговых инициативах. Опыт поддержки кросс-функциональных проектов и работы с несколькими приоритетами одновременно. Сильные аналитические и числовые навыки. Опыт работы с большими массивами данных и отчетностью по показателям эффективности. Развитые организационные навыки и навыки координации проектов. Внимательность к деталям и способность работать в условиях сжатых сроков. Навыки анализа и решения проблем. Эффективные коммуникативные и презентационные навыки. Умение эффективно взаимодействовать с командами из разных функций и стран. Самостоятельность и ориентация на постоянное совершенствование. Ориентация на результат, высокая степень ответственности и дисциплина исполнения.

COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
TEAM OVERVIEW
KKR’s Human Capital Benefits & Wellness team is responsible for implementing and enhancing the benefits programs and healthcare services for all KKR employees. The team analyzes workflows and technology solutions to align with the firm’s culture and value while providing optimal experiences. The team is also involved in every employees’ journey at KKR, from onboarding to off-boarding, travel and transfers, and even personal and professional milestones including work anniversaries..
POSITION SUMMARY
KKR’s Global Benefits function is looking for an experienced Benefits leader to help manage KKR’s benefits, including healthcare, retirement, work-life, and wellness policies/programs for the Americas.Based in Boston and reporting into the Global Head of Benefits & Wellness, this role is dedicated to driving the benefits and wellness strategy across the Americas (US/Canada/Bermuda).This individual will manage key initiatives to enhance KKR’s benefits with a significant focus on achieving greater efficiencies in benefits operations/administration, optimizing the impact of our benefits point solution ecosystem, and increasing KKR employees’ understanding and utilization of benefits plans.This is a challenging role where you will use your analytical, vendor management and project management skills as well as your creativity and resourcefulness to execute this multi-faceted strategy. Te successful candidate will be an effective communicator, collaborative team player and life-long learner.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Manage the Americas benefits plans and associated vendor/broker relationships as well as the annual US Open Enrollment cycle
Analyze and enhance the overall benefits and healthcare process workflows and technology solutions, with a focus on optimizing benefits operations with key stakeholders such as Payroll, Human Capital Operations/HRIS, Human Capital Business Partners, Legal, and Employee Relations.

Enhance the benefits governance framework and drive operational efficiencies across all benefits programs and systems
Partner with Finance/Payroll teams to ensure thorough analysis, trend forecasting, and budgeting to drive effective business planning for both short- and long-term needs
Own the development and delivery of effective marketing strategies, communication materials and policy documents for Americas benefits and wellness programs
Identify and drive enhanced benefits-focused employee experiences in areas such as on-boarding, off-boarding, global mobility/transfers, and other work-life milestones such as work anniversaries, birth/adoption of a child, etc.
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, HR or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience working in a dynamic, pressurized and matrixed environment with a focus on collaboration and key stakeholder management
Motivated self-starter with the ability to work with a high degree of autonomy
Commitment to confidentiality and experience interacting with employees’ complex private medical and financial matters; HIPAA training to be completed upon hire
10+ years of experience with US employee benefits plan development, delivery & strategy
Proven track record in health/wellness and work-life programs
Significant experience in retirement plans from a governance standpoint
Experience as a people manager with direct reports in multiple locations
CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS
Deep knowledge of Americas benefits plan design including healthcare, work-life and retirement plans along with associated complexities of plan administration, associated payroll processes, regulatory requirements and benefits taxability
Exceptional project management skills with the ability to deliver on tight deadlines with follow through and attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface with all levels of the organization, including senior business leaders
Strong sense of accountability, sound personal judgment and commercial acumen, including an understanding of competitor offerings and general marketplace with the ability to use data to influence key stakeholders
Proven ability in vendor/broker/consultant relationship management and establishing effective partnerships with external service providers to ensure quality service, including but not limited to working with HRIS systems such as Workday
Successful record of building efficient operational processes and demonstrating influence with key internal and external stakeholders
Experience managing processes, reporting and benefits data in HRIS systems such as Workday

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic runs some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world, across multiple hardware platforms. We work from the chip level up with our silicon partners, and we are now deepening that investment by building a custom silicon team.
You will be one of a small number of people covering a large surface. We are opening searches across the key domains below, and we are interested in candidates whose center of gravity sits in any of them:
Front-end design
Pre-silicon verification
Physical design
Design for test
Analog and mixed-signal
Technology and foundry
CAD and design infrastructure
Packaging, signal integrity, and power integrity
This is a role for someone who has shipped silicon, has a realistic relationship with schedules, and is comfortable making consequential calls without a large organization behind them.
Key responsibilities
Take part in end to end activities for the program: strategy, specification, execution and the technical bar.
Write the specifications and interface definitions that others design against and keep them coherent as the architecture converges
Make and own directional calls: technology and IP selection, where we build versus buy versus license, and where we take design authority versus rely on partners
Build and share AI-assisted approaches to the code-like parts of your domain, and help the team learn what Claude can genuinely accelerate
Contribute to the architecture and micro-architecture discussion from your domain's perspective, including the tradeoffs your area imposes on the rest of the chip
Partner with Anthropic's inference, performance, kernels, and infrastructure teams on hardware-software co-design, and with our hardware systems team on bring-up and integration
Support first-silicon bring-up and debug when it arrives, regardless of which domain you came in through
Minimum qualifications
Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one silicon domain: front-end design, pre-silicon verification, physical design, design for test, analog and mixed-signal, technology and foundry, design infrastructure, or packaging and signal/power integrity
Direct personal contribution to silicon that taped out and shipped, with ownership you can speak to in detail
Working fluency in the domains adjacent to your own, sufficient to reason about chip-level tradeoffs outside your specialty
Experience working with external partners — ASIC houses, IP vendors, foundries, or test partners — including reviewing their work and holding a technical bar
Track record of owning directional technical decisions and their consequences, not only making recommendations
Practical experience using AI coding tools in your own work, and clear ideas about where they help and where they do not
Clear written and verbal communication, and experience driving alignment across teams and organizations
Comfort operating with high autonomy and little scaffolding on a highly dynamic program
Preferred qualifications
Experience on machine learning accelerators, high-performance compute, or other large, high-bandwidth designs
Experience on a founding or early-stage silicon team, including standing up flows, methodology, or tooling from nothing
Experience with both partner-executed and fully in-house programs, and a view on the tradeoffs between them
Familiarity with the chip-package-system interface and the tradeoffs that cross it
Experience with hardware-software co-design and working directly with compiler, kernel, or runtime teams
Experience building or extending AI-assisted design, verification, or physical design flows
Depth in memory subsystems, on-die interconnect, numerics, or low-power design
Representative projects
Writing the specification for a compute datapath and defending its numeric format strategy against the alternatives
Standing up front-end flows and release management from scratch, then handing releases to an ASIC partner on a fixed cadence
Running fast in-house place-and-route loops on a critical block and feeding PPA reality back into the architecture
Selecting and qualifying PHY IP, then validating it on first silicon
Building a formal verification methodology for a new block and deciding where formal earns its keep versus simulation
Defining test strategy and the automated-test-equipment handoff interface with our partner
Prototyping a Claude-assisted workflow for RTL review, coverage triage, or specification consistency checking, and reporting honestly on what it did and did not do
Debugging a first-silicon failure that crosses your domain and someone else's

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

Vous travaillerez sur le volet géométrie de cette chaîne, en apportant une véritable expertise en géométrie 3D et en mathématiques appliquées. Les données en entrée sont volumineuses, denses et générées par machine. Les résultats en sortie doivent s'afficher à des fréquences d'images interactives, sans artefacts visuels. Tout l'intérêt se situe entre les deux : le traitement doit fonctionner sans supervision, sur des scènes bien plus grandes que ce que les budgets mémoire voudraient. Ce que vous ferez Travailler sur les algorithmes géométriques au cœur de l'importation et de l'optimisation d'actifs : transformer la géométrie source en maillages affichables, réduire la complexité des maillages et générer des niveaux de détail (LOD). Améliorer le traitement des données imparfaites : combler les trous, corriger les géométries dégénérées et inversées, et rendre exploitables en aval des données sources douteuses. Résoudre les enjeux de robustesse, d'empreinte mémoire et de temps d'exécution à l'échelle réelle de nos clients, afin qu'un algorithme qui fonctionne sur un modèle de test tienne également sur une scène plusieurs ordres de grandeur plus grande. Suivre la littérature scientifique et traduire les travaux de recherche publiés en géométrie en code C++ de production. Livrer ce travail sous la forme d'un service cloud automatisé fonctionnant à grande échelle. Aider l'équipe à déterminer où les outils d'IA apportent une réelle valeur dans le travail de géométrie et de systèmes, et où ce n'est pas le cas. Nous les utilisons quotidiennement et nous sommes encore en phase d'exploration. Ce que nous recherchons Solide expérience professionnelle du C++ moderne dans un contexte de production sensible aux performances. Compétences réelles en géométrie 3D et en mathématiques, acquises en production. Capacité à raisonner sur la robustesse numérique : comportement des nombres à virgule flottante, tolérances et cas dégénérés qui mettent en échec le code géométrique. Expérience du profilage et de l'optimisation sur des charges de travail gourmandes en mémoire. Aisance à lire des articles académiques ou techniques et à les implémenter. Expérience de l'utilisation d'outils d'IA dans votre flux de travail d'ingénierie. Vous pourriez aussi avoir Expérience avec des moteurs temps réel. Expérience du calcul GPU appliqué à la géométrie ou au traitement d'images. Expérience de l'exécution de code natif en tant que service cloud à grande échelle. Veuillez noter que nous ne sommes pas en mesure d'offrir un accompagnement pour l'obtention d'un visa ou une aide à la relocalisation pour ce poste. -- We are hiring a Senior C++ Developer to join our Industry Engineering team here at Unity, based in our Montreal office and working closely with engineers and and clients based in the North America region. This group builds the import and optimization path that brings large, heavy engineering and design data into a real-time engine, for our non-gaming customers. You will work on the geometry side of that path, bringing real depth in 3D geometry and the math behind it. The inputs are large, dense, machine-generated geometry. The outputs have to render at interactive frame rates without looking wrong. Everything interesting happens in between, and it has to work unattended, on scenes far larger than memory budgets would like. What you'll be doing: Work on the geometry algorithms behind asset import and optimization: turning source geometry into renderable meshes, reducing mesh complexity, and generating levels of detail. Improve how imperfect input is handled: closing gaps, fixing degenerate and inverted geometry, and making questionable source data usable downstream. Solve for robustness, memory footprint, and runtime at real customer scale, so that an algorithm which works on a test model also holds up on a scene orders of magnitude larger. Read the literature and translate published geometry research into production C++. Deliver this work as an automated cloud service that runs at scale. Help the team work out where AI tooling genuinely helps in geometry and systems work, and where it does not. We use it daily and are still figuring this out. What we're looking for: Deep professional experience with modern C++ in a performance-sensitive production context. Real 3D geometry and math skills from production work. Ability to reason about numerical robustness, including floating-point behavior, tolerances, and the degenerate cases that break geometric code. Profiling and optimization experience on memory-heavy workloads. Comfort reading academic or technical papers and implementing them. Experience utilizing AI tooling in your engineering workflow. You might also have: Experience with real-time engines. Experience with GPU compute for geometry or image processing. Experience running native code as a scaled cloud service. Experience with internal developer tools, SDKs, LiveOps, analytics platforms, or backend systems.
